extracted text: The paper studies Al-12Si alloys with various transition element contents processed with and without ultrasonic melt treatment (UST). The alloys were heat treated using a T7 treatment, which consisted of solution treatment at 490°C for 2h followed by aging at 230°C for 5h. The tensile tests were performed at both room temperature (25°C) and elevated temperature (350°C). For high-temperature tests, samples were isothermally maintained at 350°C for 100h to simulate piston operating conditions. UST was performed using a titanium sonotrode at 750-700°C for 1 minute with an amplitude of 20μm and frequency of 19kHz.
